subject: Legacy credit migration + packaging exception for LaunchPad cohort
messages:
From: Catherine Blake <catherine@launchpad.dev>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Legacy credit migration: LaunchPad cohort 7

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — LaunchPad cohort 7 is excited to try Redwood for their demo days. I have a slightly awkward request: our legal/ops team found an old statement of free credits (attached) issued under our prior sponsor agreement with Redwood. The credits are labelled as "experimental sandbox credits (v1)" and were intended for cohort members, but the new onboarding flow maps to the updated sandbox pool.

Two asks: can Redwood migrate those legacy credits to the new sandbox pool so participants can redeem them without creating separate legacy accounts? Second, the cohort has a small set of enterprise seats that would like to purchase a reserved capacity conversion at a 15% discount — can we get a packaging carve-out that bundles conversion discounts with the migrated credits?

Attached: launchpad_credit_statement.pdf (statement) and cohort7_agreement.docx (cohort terms).

We'd like to have an answer before the cohort onboarding on June 10. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Catherine
Catherine Blake
Program Director, LaunchPad Accelerator
ops@launchpad.dev
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Catherine Blake <catherine@launchpad.dev>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Legacy credit migration: LaunchPad cohort 7

Hi Catherine — thanks for the details and the attachments. I've looped in Ben (sales) and Irene (ops) to scope feasibility on the migration + pricing carve-out. High level: migrating credits into the new sandbox pool is usually doable, but we need to confirm the original issuance metadata (expiry, per-user caps, sponsor tags) so we don't break accounting.

Ben / Irene — can you review the attached statement and let us know: 1) whether we can map these legacy credits to the standard sandbox pool with a manual entitlement migration, and 2) whether a combined package that includes a 15% reserved-capacity conversion discount is approvable under current promo rules? If we need an SLA exception or a manual invoice path, flag it and I'll escalate.

Catherine — we'll aim to confirm by EOD Tuesday (June 2). If we need a quick call, please share a 20-min window and I'll get it on the calendar.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships (accelerator programs)
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Legacy credit migration: LaunchPad cohort 7

Ben / Irene — forwarding Catherine's ask inline (attached files included). TL;DR: LaunchPad wants legacy sandbox credits migrated into our new sandbox pool so cohort members can redeem them. They also asked whether we can offer a 15% discount if a subset of seats convert to reserved capacity in the same packaging.

Key constraints I see:
- Accounting: legacy credits may not be tagged the same way; if we migrate we need to ensure they map to the customer/account in HubSpot so usage doesn't float into the wrong ledger.
- Expiry: the statement doesn't show an explicit expiry date, but if the credits are >12 months old we may want a validity confirmation.
- Discount stacking: our standard policy disallows stacking promo credits with reserved-capacity discounts in some cases. However, we've granted packaging exceptions for long-term partners.

Suggested path:
1) Ops creates a manual entitlement migration for the cohort (scripts exist but need an ops ticket).
2) Sales approves a one-time 15% conversion discount for up to 10 seats (contract addendum) and we memorialize via an addendum/DocuSign.
3) Finance/Revrec signoff on credit reclassification (Irene).

Irene — can you open an ops ticket and confirm if migration can be completed by June 8? Ben — can you confirm the 15% one-time packaging discount (limit 10 seats) and any legal/finance conditions you need? If approved, I'll prepare an addendum and a quick mutual action plan we can send to LaunchPad.

Thanks,
Hannah

[Attachment: launchpad_credit_statement.pdf]
[Attachment: cohort7_agreement.docx]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Catherine Blake <catherine@launchpad.dev>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Legacy credit migration: LaunchPad cohort 7 — Proposed next steps

Hi Catherine — appreciate the patience. Quick update and proposed path that's workable from sales/finance side:  

1) Credit migration: Ops confirmed we can perform a manual entitlement migration into the new sandbox pool and map credits to individual cohort participants as long as LaunchPad provides a list of recipients (email addresses) and confirms no expiry enforcement is required. Irene opened ops ticket OPS-7842 today.

2) Packaging / discount: We can approve a one-time 15% discount on reserved-capacity conversion for up to 10 seats tied to this cohort. This will be a contract addendum (one-time promotional discount) and will not be stackable with other platform-level promos. Offer valid for 60 days from signing.

3) Next steps & docs: I will prepare a short addendum and an MRP (mutual action plan) to capture deliverables: entitlement migration (Ops), participant list (LaunchPad), sign addendum (DocuSign), and reserved-capacity seat activation. Once signed, Ops will execute migration.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-12345  |  Draft DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/123abc

Catherine — if that sounds good I can have the addendum to you by EOD tomorrow. Please confirm the participant list format (CSV with email + cohort role).

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[OPS ticket: OPS-7842]
